title: Repricing Demand Charges in Metering Service Referee Backbill Settlements
content:
On an Electric Service Agreement whose rate schedule carries a demand charge, a **Metering Service** referee backbill settlement reprices demand charges according to the billing demand recorded on the repriced bills.

**Clause.** Where the service agreement's rate schedule carries a demand charge and at least one bill the referee backbill settlement reprices was billed at the schedule's minimum billing demand, the settlement reprices the energy and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges of every repriced bill plus the demand charges of the repriced bills billed above that minimum. Where the rate schedule carries a demand charge and no repriced bill was billed at the minimum billing demand, the settlement reprices the energy, Power Supply Cost Recovery and demand charges of every repriced bill. Where the rate schedule carries no demand charge, no demand charge is repriced; the settlement reprices the energy and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges.

A bill was billed at the minimum billing demand when the billing demand shown on it, in kW, equals the schedule's minimum billing demand.

## Input, judgement, output

- **Input:** the schedule's demand charge and minimum billing demand; the billing demand and demand charge of each repriced bill.
- **Judgement:** does the schedule carry a demand charge; if so, is any repriced bill at the minimum.
- **Output:** the demand charges that join the repriced energy and Power Supply Cost Recovery charges.

| Demand charge on the schedule | A repriced bill at the minimum | Demand charges repriced |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Those of bills above the minimum only |
| Yes | No | All of them |
| No | (not applicable) | None |

## Hypothetical example

A schedule with a 100 kW minimum billing demand; four repriced bills with billing demands of 100, 100, 130 and 145 kW and demand charges of 900.00, 900.00, 1,170.00 and 1,305.00. Two bills sit at the minimum, so only 1,170.00 and 1,305.00 are repriced, 2,475.00 of demand charges in all. If the first two bills had shown 101 kW instead, no bill would be at the minimum and all four demand charges would be repriced.
